info.title: Digital Product Auto-Publisher Agent API
info.description: Autonomous Agent API to create and publish digital products to 20+ marketplaces & websites from Custom GPTs.

get.description: Returns revenue, sales count, and order intelligence across connected stores for Custom GPT.
Lists all active and draft products across Gumroad, Etsy, WooCommerce, and Shopify.
Checks live connection status of all 20 marketplaces and personal websites.

post.description: Called by Custom GPT to dynamically connect and register ANY new website or marketplace.

get.description:
Called by Custom GPT to proactively monitor login status across all stores
and alert if any store has been logged out.

post.description: Syncs authenticated session from any device (phone, laptop, PC) into the Cloud Vault.
Called by Custom GPT to compose and send professional emails (pitches, deliveries, promotions).

Called by Custom GPT to orchestrate privacy-first account creation across platforms.
Protects user KYC, banking, and passwords while setting up seller accounts.

Called by Custom GPT to automatically read recent unread OTP or activation links
from inbox to complete account verification with zero manual effort.

Called by Custom GPT when a customer or lead sends an email inquiry.
Summarizes the email, identifies intent/budget, formulates a deal-closing reply,
and returns a structured alert for chat and 1-click send URL.

Called by Custom GPT to showcase user's projects, explain what the creator can build,
actively listen to customer needs, offer smart suggestions, and ask interactive follow-up questions.

post.summary: Research Market And Generate Tailored Emails
post.description:
Called by Custom GPT to research market niches, extract business pain points,
and write hyper-personalized cold outreach emails with built-in anti-ban rate limiting.

post.summary: Reply To Social And Store Messages
post.description:
Called by Custom GPT to handle incoming DMs and inquiries from LinkedIn, Etsy, Fiverr, Upwork, etc.
Generates human-like, non-spam replies with anti-block safety rules.

post.summary: Pitch Multi Domain Services And Research
post.description:
Called by Custom GPT to pitch Web Design, Data Analytics, AI Agents, or Spreadsheets,
and discover high-ticket client opportunities using Google Maps and web research.
Called by Custom GPT to build and publish a digital product to all platforms.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for the website or store (e.g. 'My WordPress Store')

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Consumer Key or Shopify Access Token (if API based)

new_product_url.title: New Product Url
new_product_url.description: Custom 1-click new product listing URL if marketplace (e.g. Etsy, etc.)

customer_query.title: Customer Query
customer_query.description: What the customer is saying, asking, or looking for

industry_or_niche.title: Industry Or Niche
industry_or_niche.description: Customer's industry (e.g., Real Estate, Crypto, Fitness, Agency, E-commerce)

email_body.title: Email Body
email_body.description: Full text/content of the customer email

product_interest.title: Product Interest
product_interest.description: Product or category the customer asked about

target_price.title: Target Price
target_price.description: Standard price of the requested product

allow_auto_reply.title: Allow Auto Reply
allow_auto_reply.description: Whether to generate and dispatch the deal-closing reply

offered_discount_percent.title: Offered Discount Percent
offered_discount_percent.description: Discount percentage offered to close the deal instantly

body.title: Body
body.description: Body content of the email or instructions for the pitch

product_link.title: Product Link
product_link.description: Optional link to digital product or store

sender_password.title: Sender Password
sender_password.description: Optional sender password or Gmail App Password

email_user.title: Email User
email_user.description: Email address to check for OTP

business_type_or_niche.title: Business Type Or Niche
business_type_or_niche.description: Target industry, e.g. 'Real Estate Brokers in Mumbai', 'Dentists in Delhi', 'Digital Marketing Agencies'

location.title: Location
location.description: City, region, or country to research

service_or_product_to_pitch.title: Service Or Product To Pitch
service_or_product_to_pitch.description: Digital asset or service to offer

max_leads.title: Max Leads
max_leads.description: Number of high-potential leads to research

sender_name.title: Sender Name
sender_name.description: Name of the person who messaged

incoming_message.title: Incoming Message
incoming_message.description: The message received from the customer/lead

brand_name.title: Brand Name
brand_name.description: Public store or creator brand name (e.g. 'Zenith Templates')

contact_email.title: Contact Email
contact_email.description: Business contact email for account creation

target_platforms.title: Target Platforms
target_platforms.description: List of platforms to set up accounts for

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Idea/topic for the digital product to generate (e.g. 'Gym Fitness & Diet Tracker')

product_file.title: Product File
product_file.description: Existing file name in workspace if publishing an already created file

no_api.title: No Api
no_api.description: Whether to use Zero-API browser automation (default True)

custom_store_url.title: Custom Store Url
custom_store_url.description: Direct URL of user's personal WooCommerce or Shopify store

custom_store_api_key.title: Custom Store Api Key
custom_store_api_key.description: Shopify Access Token or WooCommerce Consumer Key

device_name.title: Device Name
device_name.description: Name of device performing the sync
